artifact_schema.description: The unique discrete logarithm k of the deterministic secp256k1 target relative to the SEC 2 generator.

k.description: k with [k]G = Q, zero-padded to exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

statement: Solve one full-order secp256k1 discrete logarithm: find the unique scalar k in [1,n) such that [k]G = Q. Q is deterministically derived inside the pinned verifier by SHA-256 try-and-increment from the fixed public seed `cairn/crypto-goals/secp256k1/full-dlog/v1`; the target is never created as a known scalar multiple. Submit k as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The curve, generator, and prime subgroup order are the SEC 2 secp256k1 parameters. Finding a logarithm is believed to require generic work on the order of 2^128 group operations, while the checker verifies a proposed answer with a few scalar multiplications. This is a long-horizon cryptographic frontier objective, not an expectation of near-term settlement. Cairn's reward is a notional Stage 0 amount and does not represent a funded external prize.
